about: Process plan for the L&L Delrin pallet inlay (Paletteneinlage, 1005337) on the shop's Haas VF-2, clamped to its table in two setups (your decision, 2026-11-04). At 600 x 400 mm no vise holds it, and the VF-2's 406.4 mm of Y travel can't profile both 400 mm edges in one setup: the 1/2 in end mill's path across them is 412.7 mm. So Op 10 cuts everything but the far long edge, and Op 20 slides the plate 10 mm toward the front and cuts that. Written by Claude from the drawing (314-092-59986-10) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: Z is thickness (the Z=-20 face is the bottom, datum A; the nests open from the top at Z=-0.95), Y is length (600), X is width (400, from -400 to 0); the X=-400 edge is the near one in Op 10.

stock.material_note: As the drawing. 3/4 in plate, its two faces left as bought: the part is 19.05 thick (19.1 ±0.2)
stock.from: 3/4 in plate cut to 16 x 26 in by the supplier: 16 in is the VF-2's Y travel, and wider than the band saw takes

workholding.note: On a 3/4 in MDF spoilboard bolted to the table, which the through cuts run into; four step clamps on the plate's 30 mm end margins, clear of the outline's cutter path. The 16 in plate overhangs the 14 in table by 25 mm each side. It is placed so the near edge's cutter path starts at the front of the Y travel; the far edge's would end 6.8 mm past the back of it. The outline leaves four 1 mm tabs so the part stays put; they're cut at the bench

wcs.x: the centre of the plate's length
wcs.by: probe in X, Y and Z; tool setter for the tools' lengths

operations.what: Drill and ream 2X Ø8.000 slip fit for the dowels
Rough and finish the 12 nest recesses 12 deep
Finish the 12 nests 25.70 x 159.00 (+0.10/0) through and their R6.4 corners, parallel 0.2 to A
Profile the near long edge, both 400 (-0.3/-0.5) ends with their notches and the two near 45° corners, leaving tabs
Undercut the two end notches' walls 20° with their R15 corners

workholding.note: The same plate, slid 10 mm toward the front so the far edge's cutter path ends 3.2 mm inside the Y travel; X and Y picked up again from the reamed 8 mm dowel hole at its left end, by a bore cycle, and the other dowel hole probed to check it slid straight: the finished near edge stands past the front of the Y travel, where no probe reaches it (your decision, 2026-11-05)

wcs.x: the dowel hole at its left end (probe)

operations.what: Profile the far long edge to the 600 x 400 (-0.3/-0.5) outline and its two 45° corners, leaving tabs

finish.title: Cut the tabs and deburr
finish.what: Cut the four tabs and file them flush, break every sharp corner 0.2 x 45° (note 1), and countersink the back of the two dowel holes 3.0 x 45° by hand

finish.title: Check the outline, nests and dowel holes
finish.what: Check the 600 and 400 outline, the 25.70 and 159.00 nests and their 12 depth, and the Ø8.000 dowel holes with gauge pins
